text:
kai: Proposal: introduce single opaque header `X-RW-META` for resume tokens / routing hints / provenance. Keep it versioned and minimal. Thoughts?

maria: 👍 one header > many. Easier for SDKs.

ingrid: Agree. Envelope contract needed. base64(proto) with `v1:` prefix ok? who is allowed to read fields?

kai: v1: base64(proto). Proxies treat as opaque except a few well-known fields: resume_id, attempt, route_hint, sample_bit, visibility.

sam.w: Security note: teams might encode user ids and we could leak PII into logs/metrics. Require signing; consider optional encryption for sensitive routes.

maria: Mandatory HMAC signing by edge key. Add `visibility` enum: public | private — private blocks logging unless unsealed via KMS.

ingrid: Encryption via KMS is ideal but complicates cross-region failover. Need explicit key policy + degrade behavior.

kai: Route config ideas: `retry.resume.enabled` (bool), `retry.dedupe` = off|best_effort|strict, `resume.visibility` = allow|block. Default: disabled for side-effecting routes.

sam.w: Behavior on retries: edge increments `attempt` and re-signs. Backend dedupe must be opt-in. Provide Resume-Ack header when backend supports dedupe: `Resume-Ack: v1|ok|<resume_id>`.

maria: Sampling: `sample_bit` default 0. Ops can enable low-rate cluster sampling; per-route opt-in for debug. Logs must store only an 8-byte trace-hash (not raw ids).

ingrid: Proxy implementation checklist: 1) validate HMAC before trusting payload, 2) never parse unknown fields, 3) increment attempt when edge retries, re-sign, 4) drop header and emit `resume.header.invalid` metric on HMAC failure.

kai: Schema evolution: v1 forbids freeform kvs. Future versions allowed via registry change. Central PR for new route_hint enums.

sam.w: Ops concerns: key rotation, KMS fail-modes (degrade_to_hmac vs block), cross-region key sync. Need an explicit rollback plan.

maria: Also avoid retry amplification: add `origin` field (client|edge) and `origin_attempts`. Proxies should cap total retries by origin_attempts to avoid loops.

ingrid: For side-effecting routes, default `retry.resume.enabled=false`. Encourage backends to implement `Resume-Ack` for strict dedupe.

ops-bot: Created task RW-4127: "X-RW-META rollout checklist" — includes key rotation, per-route opt-in, sampling defaults, metrics to watch, and oncall ping.

kai: I'll draft RFC covering envelope format, HMAC signing, visibility & sampling flags, route-level knobs, Resume-Ack, and rollout checklist. Tag infra/ops for KMS options.

maria: thanks — if you can include migration plan for older proxies that don't understand header, that'd be great (compat: unknown headers ignored, edge can fallback to headerless retries).

kai: noted. I'll include compatibility and a small example proto in the RFC.
